name: AKU Library Hosts Fun Day for Kids

content.title: AKU Library Hosts Fun Day for Kids
content.summary: Dar es Salaam library staff inspire a love of learning and healthcare professions

content.text: Imagine a day filled with laughter, creativity, and a spark of curiosity. That's exactly what the Aga Khan University (AKU) Library in Dar es Salaam delivered when it hosted a vibrant Library Fun Day for AKU staff and their families. Over 70 children, aged between three and 14, were immersed in a world of interactive activities designed to foster a lifelong love of learning.

The event was more than just a fun day out. It was a strategic initiative to inspire future generations of learners and leaders. By encouraging a passion for reading and exploration from a tender age, AKU aimed to ignite curiosity about higher education and the healthcare professions.

The day was a whirlwind of creativity. From painting and colouring to engaging reading sessions, the children were encouraged to express themselves and explore their imaginations. For the older teens, the focus shifted to the digital realm, with opportunities to explore online learning resources. By incorporating technology into the mix, AKU emphasized its importance in modern education and inspired curiosity about the vast knowledge available at our fingertips.

A team of dedicated students from the School of Nursing and Midwifery, East Africa (SONAM EA) and the Institute for Educational Development, East Africa (IED EA) played a vital role in making the day a success. Their enthusiasm and guidance ensured that the children not only had fun but also gained valuable insights into the world of learning.

One of the highlights of the day was a special tour of AKU's Salama House campus. The children were captivated by the university's state-of-the-art facilities, including the skills and science labs. Witnessing firsthand how simulation education is used to train future healthcare professionals left a lasting impression on the young learners. Many expressed their excitement and newfound aspirations to become doctors and nurses.

As the day drew to a close, the children left with smiles on their faces, their minds filled with new ideas, and their imaginations sparked by the world of books and science. The Library Fun Day was more than just a one-time event; it was a seed planted in the minds of young learners, nurturing their curiosity and inspiring them to reach for the stars.
